description: Deep-merge public, private or unsafe metadata into an instance's user. Existing nested objects merge recursively and null-valued keys are removed at merged levels. New or replacement nested objects are copied as-is, including nulls, matching BAPI. Repeating such a patch can change its result. Arrays replace existing arrays. Omitted fields and top-level null leave metadata unchanged. Returns only a confirmation, never metadata values. With dry_run, returns the target and supplied metadata categories without writing or showing values.

dry_run.description: Preview the target and metadata categories without writing or returning values.

instance.description: Instance to target: "development", "production", or a full instance ID (ins_…).

private_metadata.description: Private metadata merge patch, available only through backend APIs. Never returned by this tool.

public_metadata.description: Public metadata merge patch, visible to the frontend. Limit 8 KB per field.

unsafe_metadata.description: Unsafe metadata merge patch, also writable by the user through frontend APIs.

user_id.description: Clerk user ID (user_…) in the selected instance.

workspace.description: The workspace to act in, as its ID or name. A workspace is the Clerk Dashboard organization that owns the applications, not an Organization inside an application (those go in `organization_id` on the tools that have it). Only needed when this connection covers several workspaces; the error for a missing choice lists them.

name: update_user_metadata
